intent: Specify the Two-Way substring-search API of `memchr::arch::all::twoway`: the critical-factorisation helpers `Suffix::forward(needle, kind)` and `Suffix::reverse(needle, kind)` (both `SuffixKind`s; Lean: `arch.all.twoway.Suffix.forward` / `.reverse`, returning a `Suffix` with fields `pos` and `period`), and the reverse searcher `FinderRev::new(needle)` together with `FinderRev::rfind(&self, haystack, needle)` (Lean: `arch.all.twoway.FinderRev.new`, `arch.all.twoway.FinderRev.rfind`).

manual_mutants.note: forward Skip case forgets the +offset+1 when updating the period (position still right, period wrong)
reverse Accept keeps the old period instead of resetting it to 1
Minimal accepts on equal bytes: picks the shorter suffix on prefix ties (true minimum), contrary to the documented choice of `aa` over `a`
manual_mutants.after: | arch.all.twoway.SuffixKind.Minimal => if candidate = current then ok arch.all.twoway.SuffixOrdering.Accept else

manual_mutants.note: reverse finder picks the right-most instead of the left-most critical position
empty needle reported at position 0 instead of haystack.len()
small-period test uses > instead of >= at exactly half the needle
byteset prefilter query uses a different bucket (% 63) than construction: false negatives skip real matches

sibling_mutants.note: approximate byte set buckets bytes by b / 4 instead of b % 64 (different but valid prefilter representation)
reverse suffix of an empty needle reports period 0 (the period of an empty string is not meaningful)

bug_variants.source: https://github.com/BurntSushi/memchr/commit/1233467fa645b8536834801a24d101401b848f29 (fixes the reverse Two-Way of bstr 89f1aba63fdafba263be56f068d9b86ee836228e; regression test `regression_rev_small_period`)
bug_variants.note: small-period reverse search reports a match only when the left-to-right verification stops exactly at `shift` (`j == shift`) instead of `j >= shift`: after a period shift the verified window can end past `shift`, so real occurrences are missed (rfind("ababaz", "abab") = None instead of Some(0)); breaks 'returns the last occurrence'
